all: China Eximbank provides $101.4 million USD overseas investment loan to Xi'an Aircraft Industry for its acquisition of a 91.95% equity stake in FACC
Bank of China contributes to €1.25 billion EUR syndicated bridge loan to CPI Property Group to finance its acquisition of a 47.82% stake in S IMMO AG
China Eximbank provides loan to Sany Heavy Industry to facilitate its acquisition of 10.5% stake in Palfinger AG
ICBC provides a loan to Phoenix Tree HSC Investment for the acquisition of a 100% stake in Steyr Motors GmbH
ICBC provides a €23.292 million EUR loan to Shanghai Safbon Water Service to facilitate its acquisition of KWI Corporate Verwaltungs GmbH
China Eximbank provides RMB 45 million loan to Harbin Boao Environmental Technology to facilitate its 100% acquisition of P&P Industrietechnik GmbH
CRRC donates 150,000 masks and 3,000 protective suits to ASB in March 2020
ICBC donates 38,500 masks and 3,000 test kits to the Austrian Red Cross for support during the COVID-19 pandemic
Bank of China donates 100,000 masks to the Austrian Red Cross for support during the COVID-19 pandemic
